convertibility_reason: D'Alembert betting system with partial close/scale-in, margin-dependent position sizing, exposure-based currency value tracking across multiple symbols, hedging logic, tick-level execution with NoWorkTime throttling, and broker-specific margin checks. Heavy pending order management is not used, but the multi-symbol exposure system, partial close mechanics, and margin-dependent risk controls make it MT5 platform-dependent.

derived_values.name: Currency exposure V[] - net EUR-denominated exposure per currency (EUR,USD,JPY,CHF,GBP,CAD,AUD)
derived_values.formula: sum of (position_volume / EUR+Val1_ask) for each open position, signed by buy/sell and base/quote
derived_values.used_by: Exposure limits, entry gates, position sizing

derived_values.name: LotV - total absolute exposure across all currencies
LotP - total position volume in EUR-lots
derived_values.formula: (sum of all position volumes in EUR) / 2.0

derived_values.name: FreeBalance - available money for loss absorption
TP - TakeProfit delta in price for each order
derived_values.used_by: BUY, SELL order construction, D'Alembert ladder

derived_values.name: BestBalance - highest balance achieved (loss protection)
derived_values.formula: max(BestBalance, AccountBalance) updated after each CleanBad close

derived_values.name: FreeTrade - high margin flag allowing exposure limit bypass
derived_values.used_by: Entry gates for new positions and scale-in

params.tp_trailing: ORDER_TP_BUY/SELL moves TP closer by KTP% when profit exceeds loss

other_exits: Partial close (SELL against BUY position / BUY against SELL position) when price reaches Take - (NLots/LotMin - 1)*TP for longs or Take + (NLots/LotMin - 1)*TP for shorts
CleanBad: close losing position by LotMin when AcceptedLOSS is true or CloseOne flag is set (drawdown mode)
TP trailing: ORDER_TP_BUY/SELL moves TP closer by KTP*TP when max profit position exceeds max loss position
Low margin exit: close positions when ACCOUNT_MARGIN_LEVEL < MinMargin with high exposure, or < 123.4 unconditional

params.kstart_multiplier: KStart (e.g. 7) for new position opening volume in eq3-06
params.lot_at_risk: LotAtSend = LotAtRisk (1.75 or 0.75) before LastRiskDate, else LotMin

position_sizing.conditional_logic: New position: KStart*LotMin. Scale-in: LotMin per step. Partial close: LotMin. D'Alembert: volume increases by LotMin when price moves against position (TP-ladder spacing), decreases by LotMin when price moves toward TP. Total position capped at Limit_Position_Lot per symbol, exposure capped at Limit_Exposure_Lot per currency value.

custom_logic_notes: D'Alembert betting system: position volume increases when price moves against the position (adding LotMin at each TP-ladder step) and decreases when price moves toward take-profit (partial close by LotMin). The TakeProfit level is set as a price ladder where each step is TP = max(KTP*price, 2*stops_level, spread). Multi-symbol currency exposure is tracked via V[] array - net EUR-normalized exposure per currency. Entry is gated by exposure limits (Limit_Exposure_Lot per currency) and a FreeTrade flag (margin level > 2x max(MinMargin,400)). Loss management (CleanBad) partially closes the worst losing position when FreeBalance can absorb the loss. TP trailing (ORDER_TP_BUY/SELL) moves take-profit closer by KTP% when the best profitable position exceeds the worst losing one. CloseOne flag triggers aggressive loss-closing when equity drops below 90% of balance. NoWorkTime parameter throttles execution frequency. Inverse input flips all action directions. Hamilton cycle constraint noted for SPos[] array. LastRiskDate disables aggressive sizing after competition deadline.
python_conversion_notes: The multi-symbol currency exposure system (V[] array with EUR-normalized lot conversion) requires a portfolio-level state manager, not a single-symbol approach. The D'Alembert ladder logic (scale-in on adverse moves, partial close on favorable moves) needs precise position tracking with per-symbol NLots/LotMin step counts. CleanBad loss management depends on real-time margin level and balance/equity ratios. The FreeTrade flag bypasses all exposure limits, requiring careful margin simulation. TP trailing logic (ORDER_TP_BUY/SELL modifying SLTP) requires position modification support. The NoWorkTime throttle and Sleep(5555) in OnTrade affect execution timing in backtests. Must simulate: PositionSelect, SymbolInfoTick, AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_LEVEL), and the global state variables (BestBalance, CloseOne, FreeBalance) across all symbols simultaneously.
